modules.name: Login
modules.description: Authentication (User Id + Password), validation messages, session creation and logout. Forgot Password / Forgot User ID / Activate Account links exist but their flows are unverified.

modules.name: Home
modules.description: Landing page after login: top bar with alerts/notification badges, side navigation, 'Alerts & Internal Updates' with All/Important tabs, and a 'Savings Application' button.

modules.name: About Us
modules.description: Static product information page (Key Capabilities, Powerful Features, Platform Benefits). Read-only.

modules.name: My Profile
modules.description: Read-only profile of the signed-in user (name, gender, date of birth, mobile, email, address, role label).

modules.name: Notifications
modules.description: Paged list of notifications (All / Unread tabs, page size 5, Mark All as Read). Mark All as Read changes real data and must not be run casually.

permissions: See nav items Home, My Profile, Notifications, About Us

flows.name: Profile menu

acceptanceCriteria.text: Clicking Login with both fields empty shows 'Enter User Id' and creates no session.
User Id filled and password empty shows 'Enter password'.
Wrong credentials via Enter key show toast 'The credentials you entered are incorrect', user stays on /login, message does not name the wrong field.
Valid credentials land the user on /HOME.
Logout returns to /login with toast and /HOME can no longer be opened directly.
Password field is masked (dots) after typing.
Nav items change the URL to /HOME, /MY_PROFILE, /NOTIFICATIONS, /ABOUT_US.
Avatar menu lists My Profile, Change Password, Change Language, Logout.
Every profile field is disabled (not editable).
At most 5 records per page; Previous disabled on page 1.
